Anjali Naidu
QA Automation Engineer | Chennai, Tamil Nadu
anjali.naidu344@example.com | +91 9830346387

Experienced QA Automation Engineer with a strong focus on web application testing and CI-driven pipelines. Practical background in designing and maintaining TestNG suites, Selenium-based frameworks, and integrating automated tests with Jenkins for fast feedback cycles. Collaborative team player comfortable working in Agile environments and documenting test strategies in Confluence.

- Used Jira to log and track defects and Confluence to maintain test plans and runbooks for the QA team.
